role: post-development saved-state diagnostic; no holdout confirmation
gain: lpips_pq-lpips_pr using newly drawn P and Q per state/draw
weighting: average 8 draws within state, 2 original trajectories within class, equal 24 classes
fixed_parent_mcse: sqrt(sum_u sample_var_r(Z_u,r,ddof=1)/(48^2*8)), paired across selectors at same r; class uncertainty excluded

decomposition.m: mean(G|I=1), defined as 0 when no observed change per explicit user instruction
decomposition.identity: mean(G)=h*m; nonchanged G must equal zero

split_half.candidates: unique selected times per original trajectory
split_half.transfer: 0.5*(mean_B G at A winner + mean_A G at B winner)

prediction.weighting: original trajectory equally weighted, within trajectory unique times equally weighted
prediction.bins_rule: left closed, right open except final; pre-outcome fixed absolute LPIPS prediction intervals
prediction.correlation: weighted selected-set descriptive, not compared directly with original full bank

precision.metric_and_analysis: float64 inputs and NumPy double; source LPIPS values preserved

missing: fail completeness; no zero fill or inner-join reduction
status_rule: primary PENDING until every expected state/draw complete and validated
